message.content:
The earlier 0.25 m³ figure was not verified and should not be relied on. I’m checking the article record and archived copies for the exact calculation.
```python
record_check = await web_fetch("https://journals.le.ac.uk/ojs1/index.php/jist/article/view/733", max_chars=20000)
print(record_check)
```
I’m querying web archives for the now-missing Leicester PDF, using the exact historical download URL.
```python
archive_check = await web_fetch("https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=journals.le.ac.uk/ojs1/index.php/jist/article/download/733/684&output=json&filter=statuscode:200&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,mimetype&collapse=digest", max_chars=20000)
print(archive_check)
```
I’m checking the article’s indexed metadata and full-text snippets through OpenAlex’s work record, which may preserve the paper text even though the PDF endpoint is gone.
```python
full_record = await web_fetch("https://api.openalex.org/works/W2604289102", max_chars=30000)
print(full_record)
```
I couldn’t verify the volume from the available sources.
